status: Primary cinematic desktop browser production. Prior mobile metrics are NOT binding for desktop art; aesthetic acceptance remains pending.

runtime.architecture_review: docs/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md — source-independent core + isolated engine/water POC; existing runtime unchanged

coordinates.origin: feet on local ground; boat origin at design waterline

architecture.roof_profile: z(t)=eave+rise*(1-t)^1.35+0.08*t^6, t=ridge-to-eave normalized; shell 0.09m; calibrate by type before production
architecture.wood_rule: column centres define beams, brackets, purlins and rafters; no nonuniform scale of a finished module
architecture.roof_lod: L0 shell+near tile rolls; L1 shell+eave rolls and baked normals; L2 closed shell+ridge+silhouette fascia
architecture.historical_status: art-directed fantasy city informed by Tang evidence; engineering defaults, not archaeological norms

characters.note: prototype dimensions only; continuous face, tailoring, expression and reach require G1 acceptance
characters.human_anatomy: Natural human proportions and familiar facial structure; do not enlarge heads or eyes. Tang identity through hair, clothing, grooming and role. Ranges are loose reference checks, never forced deformation.

barge.note: art-directed scale trial; hydrostatics and historic form unapproved

vegetation.note: actual bounds govern; street/willow/pine/blossom study shape not final

lighting.neutral_test: white/grey environment, no bloom/AO as prerequisite
lighting.night: dark blue ambient, local warm lanterns, no global cyan emission

camera.note: composition and obstacle clearance to calibrate after final dragon/bicycle rig

budgets_not_measured_performance.scope: LEGACY MOBILE FALLBACK ONLY; numeric values retained for compatibility, not desktop production caps

desktop_first.priority: 2026-10-24 user decision: main target is a high-fidelity PC web game on user's 16-inch laptop, not phone or mandatory single-HTML offline delivery.
desktop_first.viewport: 16 inches is physical size, not known pixel resolution. Test responsive 16:10 1920x1200 and 2560x1600 windows and validate actual device.
desktop_first.art: No premature low-poly/unfinished characters; complete human faces, expressions, historically adapted apparel, continuous dragon topology, architecture interiors and full four-side models.
desktop_first.source: Editable full-resolution Blender/FBX/glTF masters with verified licensing and recorded checksums; runtime variants separate.
desktop_first.textures: 2K/4K details and selective 8K authoring sources permitted when visually meaningful; no blanket 1024 texture limit for desktop.
desktop_first.distribution: Multi-file HTTPS / server-hosted delivery with per-zone or per-LOD streaming and caching allowed. Single HTML and phone are optional compatibility.
desktop_first.size: Hundreds of MB or reasonable GBs acceptable with evidence of real detail and responsible loading. Neither a fixed limit nor a requirement to bloat.
desktop_first.performance: Benchmark true PC hardware for frame time, GPU memory, startup, steady-state, bandwidth and quality. Avoid hard claims before measuring.
desktop_first.legacy_budget_scope: budgets_not_measured_performance contains historical mobile figures; never use its 45MiB/1K/192MiB limits for desktop hero assets.
desktop_first.migration: Keep effective Three.js r160 and game systems unless demonstrated reasons to switch.
desktop_first.geometry: User explicitly forbids reducing model detail to save bytes. Desktop default retains original high-resolution geometry/texture detail; rejected 45k/1K dragon experiments are not production assets.

system_architecture.decision: top-down district/story/complete environments + bottom-up licensed mature sources/visual water/physics/audio and PC profiling
system_architecture.engine_migration_policy: User allows now, but only after controlled same-scene A/B with rollback and retire obsolete code
system_architecture.content_contract: single world/district graph, asset registry, water domain/collider/river geometry, streamed GLB/KTX2
system_architecture.asset_pipeline: editable Blender source -> provenance/hash -> glTF2 GLB and runtime LOD, keyed by sole asset id

lake: environment reflections and transparent shallow shore
creek: spline-shaped riverbed and continuous local velocity flow field
normals/foam/suspended matter move along bent local flow
rocks/bridge pillars create eddies/foam and small rapids
water_system_requirements.consistency: surface geometry, navigability, collision, water map and boat waterline from same source
water_system_requirements.acceptance: dynamic multiple-frame real-browser capture, continuous flow and reflection, NaN guards and actual desktop frametimes
